0.107: Cleaner combat audio: fewer sounds piled on top of each other, a rebalanced mix (rare finds and loot are audible now) and a limiter as a safety net
Music no longer dips into silence every ~20 seconds
Sounds come from where they happen (the knight on the left, enemies on the right) and land with the blow
Crits ring, mega crits hit deeper, OVERKILL booms; the music dips under the big moments
New VOLUME sliders (master, music, effects) in the top-right corner
0.106: OVERKILL now gets a huge banner and a red-hot flash when one blow wipes the room
Mega crits are twice as common (one crit in five)
0.105: Testing: ?debug toggles to force crits and mega crits
0.104: Critical hits now vary in damage
New: rare MEGA CRITS that hit 1.5x harder than a normal crit
0.103: Play stats now reach the developer automatically
0.102: Descending with XP or coins still to spend now asks first
Play stats are shared automatically (anonymous) so the developer sees every tester's runs

Smoother backgrounds: the fog costs far less, high-DPI screens render fewer pixels, and slow devices lower quality step by step instead of stuttering
0.100: Critical hits, potions and revives now light up the scene around the fighter — walls and mist nearby catch the glow
0.099: Drifting mist in the backgrounds: thicker over long views, a light haze indoors
0.098: Faster start: the title appears without waiting for the dungeon art to load
0.097: Run-end screen counts cleared rooms correctly
Smoother menus on slower screens (removed a costly background blur)
Loot summary no longer lists replaced items as equipped
0.096: Shrine blessings sit in a tidy compact row (the same blessing twice shows x2)
0.095: Your runs are now recorded (for the testers' play-stats page)
Critical hits show CRIT! above the damage number
The room-wipe blow now reads OVERKILL!
0.094: The game now tells you when a new build is out, with what changed
0.093: HP, armor and enemy damage numbers are 10x bigger (same difficulty)
